# Wildcard carrier with an independent nominal result

An owned static method binds one Object formal in the invariant slot of a two-slot Serializable carrier; the other slot is unbounded. Its owned nominal result is a fixed nominal type and supplies no relationship to callback inputs, outputs or execution. Optional execution and arbitrary actual results make those distinctions observable.

Source and SDK profiles compile all generated Java units and retain original definitions, complete declaration metadata, runtime roles and Exceptions. Frozen external observers check initialization and erroneous reuse, nullable callbacks, optional execution, argument snapshots, arbitrary results, ignored calls, result casts, reentrant writes and exact partial failures. Wrong programs run before recovery; Signature-only controls preserve Code.

The `--declared-unchecked` variant preserves an explicit IllegalArgumentException
contract on the same provider body. Both source and SDK profiles retain the
original callback, late opaque result and exception identities; checked and
generic throws controls keep the original Code and remain unsupported.
